adjudicationPurpose: Explain conservative deterministic mismatches without changing or overriding the rubric result.

materialFindings.detail: The source explicitly declares metadata-only and no-customer-body/raw-payload handling, but the reconstruction emits safety.privacyControls as an empty array.
The summary is a faithful paraphrase of AGENTS.md mission text and is marked declared, but claimClass is inferred-intent instead of evidenced-intended-outcome.
incident-scribe appears directly in agent-spec.yaml, but the assessment marks the value inferred and requires confirmation.
logs.search appears directly in tools.json, but the assessment marks the value inferred and requires confirmation.

conservativeScorerFindings.detail: The output preserves operator, named incident, evidence-backed diagnosis, remediation draft, and non-mutation. The claim-class error remains material and is recorded separately.
The output places on-demand investigation in description and one-to-five runs per week in expectedFrequency; the gold expected both phrases in expectedFrequency.
Adding the word interface does not change the policy meaning.
The output preserves 30-day trace retention and additionally preserves the declared 180-day aggregate-measure retention.

The output accurately states the declared absence of revenue, availability, cost, customer-satisfaction, or other business KPIs. absent-or-unknowable is a more appropriate claim class than the gold's allowed classes.

inputIntegrityCaveat.treatment: Score the run against the task-start skill read and retain the post-start drift as a reproducibility caveat; do not call the run fully immutable.
